Source title: Codes - Flex Statement
Source URL: https://www.ibkrguides.com/reportingreference/reportguide/codes_flex.htm
Retrieved at: 2026-07-26
Page last updated: May 5, 2026

Locator: Main content, "Codes" table

C | Closing Trade
Ca | Cancelled
Co | Corrected Trade
O | Opening Trade

Scope note:

This official table proves the meanings of these values in the Flex statement
Code column. It does not identify the raw XML attribute that carries them and
does not prove correction/cancel source or target identity.
